raw_text: Full type hints; Pythonic constructs; SOLID, composition, interfaces, dependency injection. Naming: descriptive `snake_case`, `PascalCase`, `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`; avoid single-letter identifiers (including `i`, `j`, `a`, `b`) except in tight math helpers. Self-documenting; docstrings only public APIs/non-obvious rationale; no noisy inline comments. Specific exceptions; never `except:` bare; actionable context. No wildcard imports; group stdlib/third-party/local; small cohesive modules. Testable pure functions; no globals/singletons. tests: use `pytest`; keep the tests to a minimum; use parametrized tests when possible; do no add useless comments; the tests shall be self-explanatory. pytest fixtures avoid duplication; `conftest.py` shared fixtures; `tmp_path` for file systems.
